messages:
Maya Patel: kickoff for Velox Systems onboarding. Short thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 10-day pilot plan. Pilot feature flag target date 2026-04-12. Velox contacts: Jorge (IT), Lina (PM). Primary goals: 95th pct latency <200ms under pilot bursts (~1k rps), uptime >=99.9%, cost target < $0.015/token. Private deployment (VPC), KMS, and audit exports required. Who owns what?

Arun Singh: I9ll own integration and smoke tests. Recommend quantized chat model variant (validated on A10G). Will open config PR with batching+KV cache. Need staging creds to validate routes.

Priya Gomez: I9ll run timeline and enablement. Propose three sessions: infra sync (env & network), prompt tuning, monitoring+runbook. Suggested: 4/2 14:00 PST, 4/4 10:00 PST, 4/6 11:00 PST.

Jorge Alvarez: Velox prefers afternoons PST 4/1-4/5. On-prem staging via IP allowlist. We want Private deployment into our VPC; KMS keys ready. Two asks: limit logs retention to 30d and provide SOC2 evidence export.

Maya Patel: we can limit logs to 30d for pilot. SOC2 package exists; will attach export. Priya, please lock session times and invite Jorge and Lina.

Priya Gomez: invites sent. Infra sync agenda:
- allowlist & firewall checks
- VPC peering / transit
- KMS key exchange
- staging cred handoff
- smoke test owner & success criteria

Arun Singh: sample smoke test post-creds:
curl -X POST https://private-api.redwood.example/v1/generate
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
  -d '{"model":"velox-llama-q4","input":"hello"}'
I9ll add a harness asserting 95th pct latency with retries. PR by EOD 3/30.

cs-bot: onboarding-checklist updated; infra-sync scheduled; SOC2 export attached to /onboarding/velox/documents.

Jorge Alvarez: clarify acceptance gate: can short spikes be tolerated if averages are ok? Need explicit gate for feature flag.

Maya Patel: proposal: flag enablement requires 95th pct <=200ms and <=5% dropped requests during a 1-hour stress window at pilot rate. Breach -> keep flag off and fallback to hosted model. Arun to add rollback trigger.

Arun Singh: confirm. Will add rollback policy, dashboard panels for 95/99 pct and error rate, and a 10% canary before full roll.

Priya Gomez: action items: 1) Arun: config PR + harness + rollback (due 3/30). 2) Maya: SOC2 export & docs (due 3/31). 3) Priya: calendar invites & agenda (done). 4) Jorge: provide staging creds & allowlist (ASAP). Reconvene post-infra sync to validate smoke test.

Jorge Alvarez: creds and allowlist posted to secure vault; pinged your team. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: thanks team. I9ll share a short recap doc after infra sync and tag owners: @Arun @Priya @Jorge. :white_check_mark:
